planets.name: TOI-125 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-125 with a 9.15-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: TOI-125 c was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-125. Its orbit and size follow Nielsen et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
